result.summary: Removes optional build feature definitions (`USE_DBUS`, `USE_QRCODE`, `ENABLE_WALLET`, `ENABLE_TRACING`, and `ENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER`) from the global `bitcoin-build-config.h` header. Moves these definitions to target-specific CMake compile definitions on the relevant libraries and targets (`bitcoinqt`, `test_bitcoin-qt`, `USDT::headers`, and `bitcoin_common`). Drops now-unneeded includes of `bitcoin-build-config.h` across Qt, wallet, RPC, and node source files.
result.problem: Reconfiguring build options (such as toggling GUI or wallet support after building non-GUI targets) modifies `bitcoin-build-config.h`. Because almost all targets include this header, any reconfiguration forces a full rebuild of the entire tree instead of compiling only the newly enabled targets.
evidence: Author demonstrates unnecessary rebuilds in the PR description: running `cmake -B build -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF && cmake --build build` followed by reconfiguring with `-DBUILD_GUI=ON` unnecessarily rebuilds non-GUI targets because `USE_DBUS` and `USE_QRCODE` modify the common header.
Author states this is 'a necessary prerequisite for effectively addressing #29914' (no other contributors corroborate in the record).
result.scope_notes: Most file changes are mechanical deletions of `#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>` across source files that no longer require build-wide definitions.
result.card: Removes optional build configuration macros (`USE_DBUS`, `USE_QRCODE`, `ENABLE_WALLET`, `ENABLE_TRACING`, `ENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER`) from the global `bitcoin-build-config.h` header, scoping them directly to their CMake targets instead. Currently, modifying any optional build setting touches the global config header and triggers a recompilation of every target across the project. This change ensures that toggling features such as the GUI only triggers builds for the newly enabled targets. The author notes this also acts as a prerequisite for #29914.
